name: linkstack-connector
description: Complete LinkStack management workflows for ChatGPT through the shared Bratonien MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Manage a self-hosted LinkStack instance through Bratonien MCP.
interface.longDescription: Exposes the complete Bratonien LinkStack REST management surface including profiles, links, appearance, analytics, users, instance settings, backups and API Access. Effective permissions are enforced server-side by LinkStack fine-grained API applications and can be changed without rebuilding the connector or ChatGPT app.
defaultPrompt: Show my LinkStack profile and appearance settings.
Manage my LinkStack page for me.
